site.title: viLilt — Pure On-Device Voice & Conversational Companion AI
site.description: Talk. Listen. Nothing else. 100% on-device neural voice and text AI companion for iOS & iPadOS.

hero.desc_bold: Zero agent complexity. Zero tool overhead.
hero.desc: viLilt is a pure, private on-device conversational AI companion. Featuring continuous hands-free voice dialogue, lifelike neural speech, and customizable personas without cloud latency or subscription paywalls.

orb_preview.user_speaking: “Hey viLilt, can you help me practice expressing my design ideas with more clarity and confidence?”
orb_preview.assistant_reply: “I'd love that! Start by painting the overarching vision first — tell me what feeling you want someone to have when they first open your creation. Let's walk through it together.”

personas.title: A Tone for Every Moment
personas.subtitle: Switch companions seamlessly with one tap to match your mood, study needs, or creative sparks.
personas.p1_desc: An attentive listener who offers non-judgmental support, heartfelt encouragement, and peaceful reflections.
personas.p2_desc: Sharp conceptual analogies, structured perspectives, and stimulating discussions on philosophy, career, and science.
personas.p3_desc: Practice conversational fluency in English, Mandarin, Japanese, Spanish, or French with gentle natural tips.
personas.p4_desc: Ignites imagination for storytelling, writing, catchy phrasing, and novel design concepts.
personas.p5_desc: A serene sanctuary to breathe, unwind, reflect, and find mental clarity amidst everyday noise.

models.title: Compact Intelligence. Instant Speed.
models.desc: High-efficiency conversational models running natively on Apple Silicon Neural Engine with zero data leaves your device.
models.m1_desc: Instantaneous voice turnaround time with ultra-low battery consumption. Perfect for natural conversation.
models.m2_desc: Rich multi-lingual dialogue, nuanced empathy, and fluent conversational responses across CJK & European languages.
models.m3_desc: Meta's state-of-the-art compact conversational model with exceptional English flow and logical insight.
models.m4_desc: Philosophical depth, rich persona roleplay, and advanced language tutoring capabilities.

features.title: Designed for Pure Conversation
features.subtitle: Everything you need to talk, listen, and think freely — with none of the clutter.
features.f1_desc: Bidirectional voice conversation with dynamic audio waveforms and luminous visual feedback.
features.f2_desc: Distraction-free text stream with interactive keyboard swipe-down dismissal and per-bubble listen pills.
features.f3_desc: Lifelike Edge Neural speech synthesis with immediate on-device AVFoundation fallback.
features.f4_desc: Your voice and chat never leave your device. Zero telemetry, zero cloud recording, zero analytics.
features.f5_desc: Published under the viaiforgood nonprofit initiative — free for everyone forever without paywalls.
features.f6_desc: While viLoom weaves multi-step task workflows and agent actions, viLilt holds the living conversation.
